prior_summary: Predict small SE(3) corrections in the current TCP frame and expose causal release/approach/closure cues, so each executed correction composes with the realized intermediate TCP rather than a nominal world path.
applicable_conditions: Prefer for variable predecessor handoff or intermediate execution state when the block may be at a different release height, fingers/TCP differ from the nominal phase, or closure is partially executed, while global drawer displacement is modest and geometry remains reachable.
termination_guidance: Use observed drawer position below 0.025, negligible drawer velocity, block retained inside, open fingers and a high clear TCP. Local motion magnitude or gripper sign is not a success predicate.
limitations: TCP-local corrections can preserve accumulated global offset and do not establish a global handle or destination. There is no contact truth or recovery supervision for a miss, jam, obstruction, object outside the cavity, severe scene displacement or infeasible IK.

config.action_representation: local xyz plus rotation vector plus gripper
config.phase_state: two causal observations only; no recurrent state
